English:
MERS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 can survive on inanimate surfaces such as metal, glass, or plastic for up to nine days (Huang, C.-L, 2020). This means that if a person touches a contaminated surface, they can become infected. Therefore, it is important to wash hands with soap and water after touching a surface. It is also important to wash the surface with salt water and allow it to dry before use to prevent infection.
